name: Engineering of Solution Spun Fibres
description: Solution rheology and its dependence on parameters. Effect of parameters on entanglement density, fibre spinning and subsequent drawing; various solvent systems; dope preparation; wet and dry spinning processes; effect of process parameters such as dope concentration, bath concentration, temperature and jet stretch ratio on coagulation rate, fibre breakage and fibre structure; modeling of coagulation process; properties and structure of dry and wet spun fibres; dry jet wet spinning of PAN. Viscose rayon process; polynosics and high-performance cellulosic fibre; non-viscose processes, Lyocell spinning process, structure and properties; gel spinning of PE, gel-spinning of PAN and PVA. Introduction to high-performance fibres and their spinning systems such as rigid rod polymer, liquid crystalline polymers, polylactic acid and spandex fibre manufacturing.
